conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, aiming for lower drawdowns.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets about 2.5% per month with a risk-first growth strategy. It reduces leverage and concentration while blending broad market exposure with quality tech and some income.
